project_os_preflight.confirmed_root_cause: Project OS evaluates a blocker only when its latest status belongs to a fixed five-value OPEN_BLOCKER_STATUSES set. New descriptive open statuses such as open_disposition_selected_* are silently skipped before run-scope matching.
project_os_preflight.immediate_ledger_mitigation: RC-P36-156 latest projection uses canonical status=open, wildcard blocking and an explicit allowlist for this zero-call implementation and repository hygiene.

root_cause_decomposition.finding: document_ceiling_per_query limits accepted candidates rather than document fetches, so a query can scan many documents while still looking for one accepted candidate.
The runtime completes all revisions for an earlier role before the next role receives budget; the customer slot exhausted the global ceiling before the supply slot performed a network call.

A Microsoft customer-story page is classified as customer_official_disclosure even when it describes Microsoft's customer rather than Microsoft's own infrastructure demand, so source-family matching is too coarse for the intended economic edge.
The adapter reads anchor data attributes, ISO dates in anchor text and HTTP Last-Modified, but misses explicit official release and event dates present in captured page bodies.
Structured IR and broad external site search are unavailable, customer and supply route ladders omit useful SEC alternatives, and SEC form discovery excludes foreign-issuer 20-F and 6-K forms.
One canonical SEC document bound to two roles is counted as two qualified documents; role coverage and unique-source efficiency need separate metrics.

A supply slot must bind capacity, supply, inventory or constraint evidence to the cataloged supplier, foundry, memory or compute-platform owner.

stop_rules: If the zero-call package cannot prove slot fairness, relationship direction and bounded unique-source efficiency, do not request another live attempt.
If an operational broad external provider is still absent, keep external_site_search unavailable and do not relabel official-domain index search as broad Web search.
After zero-call implementation and independent proof, make a separate fresh-live authority decision; do not inherit the consumed R2 authority.
If a later live run still has target-in-pool below the frozen gate, remain in S1-08 and reassess source-provider coverage before ranking or S3.
